description: Step 2/3: after Disconnect the card returns to the blank key field with no line that Rakazo keeps the meetings and to-dos. The mockup's 'After' puts a chat answer and a to-do directly under the card, which shows the data survives only by juxtaposition, not by any text. Ethan expected disconnect to mean removal.
expected: One short line at Disconnect or in the blank state that meetings are kept.
suggested_fix: Add one line to the card in the disconnected state (or a delete control), per catalog recommendation 3.

description: Step 5: journey breaks, no control exists to delete stored meetings (not drawn, not in the plan). Step 6 (re-paste a key and see the old meetings again) is also not drawn.
expected: A delete-all or retention statement; reconnect continuity shown.
suggested_fix: Decide: delete control vs retention line.

description: Disconnect on the Connected card is a single red click with no confirmation and no undo. Because the plan says 'no confirm about data', it is unclear whether any confirm appears at all; the mockup draws none.
expected: A stated rule (reconnect restores state) or one-step confirmation.
suggested_fix: Say in the plan that reconnecting restores everything; no dialog needed.

description: In the Inbox 'Source disconnected' state the to-dos look identical to connected ones; nothing marks them as from a disconnected source, so Ethan cannot connect the Inbox list to his disconnect. The only text is a mockup note outside the card.
expected: Optional: no marker (plan's simplest choice) but stated.
suggested_fix: Keep as designed and record it as a deliberate choice, or add a quiet source line.

description: 'After' state merges three surfaces (Integrations card, agent chat, Inbox To do card) into one pane under a sidebar that highlights 'Granola agent', with no page title or back link and 'Integrations' not highlighted. A reader cannot tell which page they are on.
expected: One screen per page, or three framed panels labelled by page.
actual: Single pane with stacked unrelated blocks.
suggested_fix: Split into three frames or label each block.

description: The note 'Granola was disconnected from Integrations. The to-dos stay and can still be completed.' on the Inbox screen is explanatory mockup text outside the card; it is not product copy but could be taken for it.
